upgrade_rule: Create a new version directory and update requirement-matrix.md and its validation test in the same change.

webhook_delivery_contract.http_fixture_scope: signature, envelope, atomic durable inbox, deduplication and acknowledgement only
webhook_delivery_contract.acknowledge_200_after: inbox transaction committed or duplicate confirmed
webhook_delivery_contract.non_2xx_means: durable ownership was not acquired; Uber should redeliver
webhook_delivery_contract.worker_fixture_scope: business payload validation, handlers, unsupported events, internal retries and DEAD state
webhook_delivery_contract.worker_failures: must not change the original HTTP 200 or request Uber redelivery
